derivation: Per-source entity floors for the deploy.yml 'Verify harmonized output'
gate. Two derivation classes:
1. fresh (au cn eu eu_vessels jp nz tr uk us wb): floor(0.70 * count)
of the 2026-07-28 full local harmonize at ammitto/ammitto
against same-day shallow clones of all 15 data repos. 70% tolerates
normal delisting churn while still failing on partial-source loss.
jp and us each harvested exactly 1 unique entity (jp: 15 dated
announcement files fail YAML-alias parsing; us: the repo holds a
single processed YAML), so floor(0.70 * 1) = 0 is clamped to 1 —
the gate requires strictly positive floors.
2. provisional (ca ch ru un un_vessels): no fresh count exists —
ca/ru ship no harmonizable YAML, un/un_vessels have no input
directory, and ch's only input YAML fails to transform (gem bug:
nil.any? on lukashenka-dzmitry-aliaksandravich.yml). Floors stay
floor(0.35 * March-committed api/v1 count); the March stats
double-count entities+entries (~2x), so 0.35 * March approximates
0.70 * real.
The retired gate floored at a quarter of the March-committed counts;
that baseline is inflated and its aggregates are malformed (untyped,
id-less @graph nodes). Regenerate this ENTIRE file from the next
reviewed full 15-source harvest — do not hand-tune individual floors.
total_entities_floor = floor(0.70 * fresh total_entities).
fresh_entity_counts is documentation only; the workflow reads
source_floors and total_entities_floor.
